reference.name: plans
reference.context: Canonical reference for all plans within the project. Plans are scopes and tasks designed for the purpose of advancing active development work.

plan.synopsis: Test suite for the updated `schema.py` used in v3.0.0.
TOML loader,validation,editor JSON Schema,v2→v3 migration.
harden promote_seed: _resolve_captions extraction + refactor
deferred from plan 3/8.3: 6.2.3 (boundary), 6.1.1 (mismatch)

Foundation: spec §6 cycles 1-3 — deep_merge utility, two-source discovery chains, _cache_path platform branching. Pure utilities, no filesystem state. Sibling plans (cache + integration) depend on these primitives.
First-run flow to set user config and ensure library sync
Diagnostics engine core (cycles 1-6): diagnose() entry, build_eval_context, rule loader/evaluator, audit log, override flow. Starter rules (cycles 7-9) deferred to sibling plan.
Diagnostics engine starter rules (cycles 7-9): shares.sum_not_100 (SCHEMA), estate.crossed_cliff (BUSINESS_RULE), extraction.placeholder_unfilled (EXTRACTION). Closes Cycle 1 integration test.
OCR extraction core (spec §6 cycles 1-3 + protocol cycle): markers, trace types, INCOMPLETE sentinel, paths.resolve, ExtractionProtocol surface. ollama>=0.6.1 dep added; 9b/9c open separately.
OCR Ollama backend (spec §6 cycles 4-6, 10): GenerationEnvelope + field-order discipline, OllamaBackend.extract happy + error paths, prompt strategy, live vision-model smoke test. Depends on 9a.

OCR diagnostics integration (spec §6 cycles 7-9): synthesize_extraction_diagnostics, diagnose() extraction namespace, verify lifecycle, override interaction, new extraction.* codes. Lands diagnostics-engine spec amendment §12. Depends on 9a.

Cache layer: spec §6 cycles 4-5 — atomic _write_cache, four-case _read_shared_with_fallback (availability/empty/integrity), SharedConfigStalenessWarning + SharedConfigIntegrityWarning. Depends on foundation plan.

Integration: spec §6 cycle 6 — load_firm_config two-source signature, _SHARED_REQUIRED_SECTIONS completeness check, shared-side path validator, fixture migration. Cycle-6 PR also lands config/firm.shared.dev.toml + config/README.md.

plan-group.synopsis: AnthropicBackend (4.3b) — Claude API impl of ExtractionProtocol. A.1 core: prompt split, envelope+mappers, ctor, dual seam, errors, conformance. A.2 instrumentation: prechecks, caching+thinking call-args, mechanism benchmark, integration smoke.

plan.synopsis: Plan A.1: prompt-module split, AnthropicGenerationEnvelope models, forked mappers, AnthropicBackend ctor + extract() pipeline + dual-mechanism seam + 10a-10f error mapping + Protocol conformance. Working backend safe to ship at endpoint.

Plan A.2: PDF size/page prechecks, image source branch, prompt-caching + extended-thinking call-args, mechanism benchmark, integration smoke. Depends on core; landed atop the working backend from Plan A.1.

plan-group.synopsis: Migrate the v3 parser layer (docx/pdf/json/registry/coercion). Hexagonal, schema-centric: every parser returns TrustData fit for diagnose(). Built test-first inside-out across 4 child plans covering 10 cycles.

plan.synopsis: Build the JSON parser (round-trip + error surfaces) and the pure coercion helpers (_to_date, _to_decimal, _to_address, _to_person_reference) consumed by docx/pdf. Cycles §6.1–§6.4.

Build the docx parser inside-out: smoke (§6.5) → asset integration (§6.6) → post-promotion contract with combinatorial trust_type/marital_status mutation tests (§6.7) → coercion + post-merge resolution (§6.8).

Build the pdf parser via AcroForm field iteration. Reuses cycle-3 coercion helpers and the _apply_post_promotion_protocol helper extracted in docx cycle 4b. Includes §5.4.A field-presence normalization.
Wire parse_file extension dispatch and update the v3.parsers public exports. Includes the test_parse_file_ignores_seed_for_json contract test (M2 from plan-review pass 1).
Residual §5.4 coercion uncovered by PR #12 review of plan-group 15: §5.4.7-docx WithdrawalStep, §5.4.8 CustomTerm (both parsers), §5.4.4 entity-fallback semantics, §5.4.7 missing-percent disposition.
